set.body: Acceptance criteria: create separate go/no-go ADRs and prototypes for uncertainty-aware measurements, dynamic-video object AOIs, transparent detector recommendations, live experiment feedback, and benchmark dashboards; each prototype names the user task, scientific assumption, validation requirement, performance budget, app contract, and failure modes; no capability enters the stable facade until its discriminator, benchmark, provenance schema, and support policy are accepted; recommendation systems explain candidates and never switch methods silently.
set.title: Capability incubator: uncertainty, dynamic video, and dashboards
